module seven_segment_decoder (
    input [3:0] digit,
    output reg [6:0] segments
);

    // Common anode display mapping
    // segments: a, b, c, d, e, f, g
    // order: [6:0] -> [g, f, e, d, c, b, a]
    // For common anode, '1' means segment is OFF, '0' means segment is ON.

    always @(*) begin
        case (digit)
            4'd0: segments = 7'b1000000; // 0 - segments a, b, c, d, e, f ON
            4'd1: segments = 7'b1111001; // 1 - segments b, c ON
            4'd2: segments = 7'b0100100; // 2 - segments a, b, d, e, g ON
            4'd3: segments = 7'b0110000; // 3 - segments a, b, c, d, g ON
            4'd4: segments = 7'b0111001; // 4 - segments b, c, f, g ON
            4'd5: segments = 7'b0010010; // 5 - segments a, c, d, f, g ON
            4'd6: segments = 7'b0000010; // 6 - segments a, c, d, e, f, g ON
            4'd7: segments = 7'b1111000; // 7 - segments a, b, c ON
            4'd8: segments = 7'b0000000; // 8 - all segments ON
            4'd9: segments = 7'b0010000; // 9 - segments a, b, c, d, f, g ON
            4'd10: segments = 7'b0011000; // A - segments a, b, c, e, f, g ON
            4'd11: segments = 7'b0000011; // b - segments c, d, e, f, g ON
            4'd12: segments = 7'b1001110; // C - segments a, d, e, f ON
            4'd13: segments = 7'b0100001; // d - segments b, c, d, e, g ON
            4'd14: segments = 7'b0000110; // E - segments a, d, e, f ON

        endcase
    end
